sectionDescription: Pi coding-agent packages shipped by this plugin. Install them into your Pi, or let Pi agents load them in Cognia-hosted sessions.
paneGroupDescription: Pi packages contributed by your enabled Cognia plugins.
pluginDisabled: Enable this plugin to install its Pi packages or load them into hosted sessions.

prepare.dialogDescription: {plugin} needs to install this package's dependencies. Cognia will run exactly this command in the package directory, without a shell:
prepare.thenInstall: The package is installed into Pi after this step succeeds.

install.noWorkspace: Open a workspace to install into the project scope.
install.successDegradedToast: Recorded {name} in Pi's settings ({scope}). Pi loads it on its next launch.
install.degraded: Pi isn't reachable, so Cognia records the package path in Pi's settings.json instead of running pi install. Pi resolves it on its next launch.

hosted.controlsSession: Takes over the session's tool surface. Agents that load it may lose access to their other tools.

errors.notFound: No enabled plugin provides this package.
errors.notOnDisk: This plugin isn't installed in a folder (built-in plugins can't ship Pi packages), so Pi has nothing to read.
errors.invalidPath: The package declares a path outside the plugin folder.
errors.notHosted: This package can't be loaded into hosted sessions.
errors.notPrepared: The package's prepare step hasn't run yet.
errors.workspaceRequired: The package needs a workspace folder.
errors.doubleLoad: This package is also installed in Pi in a scope this agent loads, so it would load twice. Switch the agent to the isolated policy, or remove the package from Pi.
errors.desktopOnly: Only available in the desktop app.
errors.noPrepare: This package has no prepare step.
errors.binaryMissing: {program} wasn't found on this machine. Install it, then retry.
errors.timeout: The prepare step ({program}) timed out after {seconds}s.
errors.exitCode: The prepare step ({program}) exited with code {code}.
errors.markerMissing: The prepare step finished but didn't produce its marker file.
errors.envConflict: Two packages this agent loads set the same setting to different values. Remove one of them from the agent.
errors.piVersion: This package needs Pi {version} or newer; this host runs {installed}.
errors.botIsolation: Bot-isolated agents can't load plugin Pi packages: the package folder lives in your home directory, which isolation hides.
errors.symlinksCreated: The prepare step created a symbolic link ({path}), and Cognia refuses to load plugins that contain links. The plugin author needs a prepare step that installs without links.

picker.label: Plugin Pi packages
picker.hint: Each selected package loads into every session of this agent, before Cognia's own extension.
picker.empty: No enabled plugin ships a Pi package that supports hosted sessions.
picker.notPrepared: Not prepared: run its prepare step from the plugin's page before starting a session.
picker.unavailable: {ref} is no longer available. Sessions will fail to start until it is removed.
